autoProviderHint: Recommended. The app detects the provider from the key and only shows models this key can actually use.
modelHint: The app filters the provider's live model list to models compatible with the current AI flow.
modelWaiting: Paste an API key first. The app will validate it and load available models automatically.
modelEmpty: No compatible model is available yet.
checkError: Could not validate the key or load models.
saveError: Could not save the API key.
pasteAndCheck: Paste a key to load models automatically
storageUnavailableTitle: Secure API key storage is not ready
storageUnavailableDescription: The server-side key store is not ready or cannot read an encrypted key. This is not a normal missing-key state; fix secure key storage before retrying.
